channel.title: Freethought on Nikita Obraztsov
channel.description: Recent content in Freethought on Nikita Obraztsov

item.title: Machiavelli on Religion: Analyses of his views
item.description: What Machiavelli thought about religion, why he almost never used the word God, how his views differed from Luther's, and whether he belongs among the freethinkers.

item.title: Benedict Spinoza: Heretic, Lens Grinder, and God as Substance
item.description: On the life and philosophy of Spinoza: excommunication from the synagogue, pantheism, the Ethics, and why Einstein invoked his name when asked about God.

item.title: Godless: A Brief History of Atheism from Antiquity to the Present
item.description: A survey lecture on the history of atheism and freethought: from ancient impiety to the New Atheists of the twenty-first century.

item.title: Friedrich Nietzsche and His Critique of Christianity
item.description: Second lecture in the series on atheism and freethought. Nietzsche as a literary figure rather than a scientist: will to power, ressentiment, The Antichrist, and why his critique of religion is not scholarship.

item.title: John Toland: The Forgotten Genius of the Enlightenment
item.description: The first lecture in a series on the history of atheism and freethought. John Toland (1669/1670–1722): biography, Christianity not Mysterious, Letters to Serena, and his place in the history of European thought.
